However, SAM can often segment fused AI blobs as one object. Visually inspecting the lower-left mid-section, the branches do appear to merge without clear bifurcation points. This is a classic AI artifact in dense organic structures. Severity 2.0 is appropriate—it's a structural flaw but doesn't destroy the overall recognition of the object.
3. Missed Artifacts: The Geometric Depth Auditor showed a clean depth map with no bleeding into the blue background. No other major artifacts were found.
